text.title: Activation Tactics Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable onboarding-funnel signals to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml. Every leaf references a rule id.

decision-tree.root-question: Is there a measured top drop-off step with its current conversion rate and a defined activation event?

conclusion.verdict: no measured drop-off to target; run activation-framework or activation-metrics first

branch.question: Does the target step already have a tactic running in the current period?

conclusion.verdict: defer; wait for the live tactic to hit or miss its exit criterion

branch.question: Where is the user when they drop: inside the product, or gone before returning?
Is a use-case or role key captured at signup for the affected users?

conclusion.verdict: branch onboarding per segment with a distinct first action; same activation event
deploy a 3-5 item checklist or a single guide on the drop-off screen; exit criterion states baseline and lift
run the 4-email sequence with send-time suppression and one direct CTA per email

text.example: top_dropoff_measured=true -> live_tactic_on_step=false -> drop_location=in-product -> segment_key_at_signup=false -> conclusion ref=r-checklist-single-activation-item
